title: Assessment integrity: official question, feedback, scoring, grading and runtime identity boundaries
summary: Official assessment starts are fail closed by default; questions are separated from practice while existing mixed-use legacy owners retain only narrow own-session continuation; cohort-safe feedback release and frozen weighted scoring are enforced; LLM grading treats answer/source text as untrusted and validates exact rubric/evidence sets; sensitive assessment SQL surfaces require the exact dou_api_runtime session identity, a closed role graph and cross-owner default-ACL cleanup. Evidence is local deterministic/fake-provider only, deployment is not started and promotion remains none.

rollout.kill_switch: Set ASSESSMENT_BLUEPRINT_ENABLED=false and restart/redeploy the API; new official blueprint starts fail closed while existing get/answer/finish/results paths remain available.
rollout.assignment: After approvals, pin an internal instructor staging pilot to an explicit course and published exam_version; any later student cohort is deterministic and version-sticky for the whole active attempt.
rollout.initial_exposure: None. Before any traffic: provision dou_api_runtime LOGIN/secret/membership, prove the production pooler preserves session_user, drain every dou_app pool, apply 0016 with the exact role graph and no unsafe cross-owner default ACL residue, prove mixed-use legacy-owner continuation plus no-session denial, and pass runtime-role readiness. First allowed exposure is internal instructor-only staging with active exams excluded.
stop_conditions: Any official question, answer key, rubric, source or score visible outside the owning paper or before its safe release time.
Any incorrect frozen weighted score, rubric/evidence validation bypass or untrusted-text grading influence.
Any readiness identity failure, unexpected role-graph edge, unsafe default ACL residue, active legacy carrier session or runtime secret disclosure.
Any active attempt unable to continue after the feature flag is disabled and the kill switch is engaged.
expand_conditions: Final OpenAPI and real-browser gates pass on the exact candidate and CI confirms the already-green backend/static/frontend package.
Frozen real-provider adversarial holdout and human assessment anchor pass without threshold changes.
Managed-pooler staging, runtime secret rotation and bounded rollback rehearsal pass.
Named independent engineering, domain and security/privacy approvals are recorded against the exact candidate.
rollout.active_exam_policy: No student candidate exposure during an active exam. Once an attempt starts, its paper, points, prompt/rubric contract and feedback release time remain version-sticky; disabling the flag blocks only new starts.

rollback.previous_compatible_artifact: base:2f40ac193114b896d33ef73e72ea51cc51f34d26 only before any 009 official attempt; before canary record a post-0016 staging-verified deployment ID
rollback.procedure: Disable ASSESSMENT_BLUEPRINT_ENABLED for new starts, preserve existing attempt routes, and deploy the last post-0016-compatible revision or a fix-forward. Keep DATABASE_URL on dou_api_runtime; never re-enable dou_app LOGIN/password or restore its sensitive ACLs. Do not drop 0016 columns/enums or rewrite historical paper/release evidence.
rollback.verification: Through the same deployment DSN/pooler, require session_user/current_user dou_api_runtime, app.is_api_runtime() true and /health/ready database_role=ok; then prove new official starts are blocked, an existing attempt can answer/finish/results, and official question/early feedback leakage remains zero.

privacy.handling: Synthetic fixture identities and aggregate pass/fail counts only. Runtime/database secrets, prompts, answers, chunks, filenames, emails, row identifiers, provider payloads and raw logs are excluded.
privacy.retention: Versioned append-only with the repository; temporary databases and local service processes are removed after each proof.
